setup_steps: 2. Export PGP keys: gpg --export --armor > public.asc && gpg --export-secret-keys --armor > private.asc
4. Create real commits in Bob's repository for both key types:
- Make one commit and sign with SSH key: git commit -S
- Make another commit and sign with PGP key: git commit -S
5. Fill in both SSH and PGP commit hashes in repositories.bob.ssh/pgp sections
6. Fill in key paths and other config values
7. Start local hardhat node: npx hardhat node
8. Run integration test: bun test integration-test

required_commits.alice: Commit containing test cases that Bob's solution should pass
required_commits.bob_ssh: Commit containing solution code signed with SSH key
required_commits.bob_pgp: Commit containing solution code signed with PGP key

testing_flow.ssh_test: Uses repositories.bob.ssh.solutionCommitHash for SSH key verification
testing_flow.pgp_test: Uses repositories.bob.pgp.solutionCommitHash for PGP key verification
testing_flow.both_mode: Runs both SSH and PGP tests sequentially with their respective commits
